fusions.name: Vise Clench
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in a crushing grip that deals 16 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrench Loose
fusions.desc: Wrenches at everything within 3.5 tiles, dealing 32 damage to each enemy. The force ignores armour.

fusions.name: Heavy Lifting
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. While it lasts, a pair of grasping hands fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Jar Lid Habit
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
